MapLibre GL JS
=============

Version: 5.6.2
Released: 2025-08-21
Source:   https://unpkg.com/maplibre-gl@5.6.2/dist/
License:  BSD-3-Clause (see maplibre-gl.LICENSE.txt)
Repository: https://github.com/maplibre/maplibre-gl-js
Tag:      v5.6.2

Files vendored from the official npm distribution, served verbatim:

  - maplibre-gl.js          UMD browser bundle (dist/maplibre-gl.js)
  - maplibre-gl.css         Stylesheet (dist/maplibre-gl.css)
  - maplibre-gl.LICENSE.txt BSD-3-Clause license text

We vendor the library instead of loading it from a CDN so the platform works
offline and so the JavaScript dependency is committed to the repository under
a known tag. Bumping the version is a deliberate code change: download the
same three files for the new tag, replace them, and update the Version line
above.
